verdict.rationale: A national company registry could plausibly offer a documented system-to-system filing channel, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two probes recording HTTP 403 at robots.txt on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in. Nothing beyond those files was fetched, so there is no evidence of system accounts, transmitter or batch-provider programs, or a published enrollment path. Confidence is low because the wall stopped any inspection of the service, not because evidence showed the channel is missing.
